# NOAA SWPC text product fixtures

Fetched from `https://services.swpc.noaa.gov/text/` on 2026-10-04, unmodified.

`sgas.txt`, `3-day-forecast.txt` and `27-day-outlook.txt` are the same issues as the Winlink replies in `../winlink/`, so tests can check that a product gives the same values whichever way it arrives. `wwv.txt` is a later issue than the Winlink one.

US Government work in the public domain.
